scope: Five frozen records originally selected through supplemental web candidate retrieval

decision_policy.candidate_retrieval: A quoted full-title web search may retrieve candidates but does not establish identity.
identity_evidence_order: unique exact journal DOI in official arXiv metadata
publisher-asserted or repository-asserted preprint relation in official metadata
manual adjudication of official titles, complete author lists, and abstract or method content
decision_policy.automatic_title_matching: Only narrow Unicode NFC, case, and whitespace normalization is allowed. Scientific punctuation, numeric syntax, subscripts, superscripts, and markup are preserved.
decision_policy.rejection: An explicit DOI conflict, no reasonable author overlap, or only topical, symbolic, or numeric similarity is insufficient and must be rejected.
decision_policy.non_hit: A web-search non-hit is unresolved; it is not evidence that no arXiv record exists.

retrieval_audit_limitations.detail: The frozen manifest retained each query and selected candidate but did not retain the underlying search provider, search time, result ranking, or all returned candidates. These missing fields cannot be reconstructed retrospectively. The decisions below therefore rely on current official journal, Crossref, and arXiv metadata, not on search ranking.

journal.title: Observation of conformal field theory spectra in a quantum simulator

candidate_retrieval.query: site:arxiv.org/abs "Observation of conformal field theory spectra in a quantum simulator"

arxiv.title: Experimental observation of conformal field theory spectra

records.content_basis: Both official records describe a Rydberg-atom chain probed by modulation spectroscopy to observe spectra associated with conformal field theory.
records.decision_basis: All authors correspond and the experimental system, intervention, readout, and scientific target agree despite the title change; no conflicting DOI is present.

journal.title: Superconducting 2D cuprate with a single CuO2 plane

candidate_retrieval.query: site:arxiv.org/abs "Superconducting 2D cuprate with a single CuO2 plane"

arxiv.title: Superconductivity in Isolated Single Copper Oxygen Plane

records.content_basis: The Nature record studies a monolayer Bi-2201 system using scanning-tunnelling and transport measurements; the arXiv record studies a half-unit-cell LSCO system using angle-resolved photoemission. Shared copper-oxide terminology does not identify the records as the same work.
records.decision_basis: The first authors differ, the author sets have no overlap, and the material systems and measurement methods differ.
records.frozen_artifact_handling: Retained in the frozen cohort denominator. The later adjudication and source review supersede the unsupported author_consistent and study_content_consistent fields without rewriting the frozen manifest.
